name.fil: Missing Child and Stranger Danger (Nawawalang Bata at Hindi Kilalang Tao)

lessons.en: Memorize your full name, address, and a parent's phone number.
lessons.fil: Kabisaduhin ang buong pangalan, address, at phone number ng magulang.

lessons.en: If lost, stay where you are and ask a store worker, guard, or official for help.
lessons.fil: Kapag naligaw, huwag umalis sa lugar at humingi ng tulong sa store worker, guard, o opisyal.

lessons.en: Never go anywhere with anyone without a trusted adult's permission, and tell a trusted adult about anything that feels wrong.
lessons.fil: Huwag sumama kaninuman nang walang pahintulot ng trusted adult, at sabihan ang trusted adult kapag may hindi magandang pakiramdam.

question.en: Which person is a trusted adult?

choices.en: A parent, guardian, teacher, or school counselor
choices.fil: Magulang, guardian, teacher, o school counselor
Kahit sinong nakakaalam ng pangalan mo

explain.en: Trusted adults are people you know well who keep you safe.
explain.fil: Ang trusted adults ay mga taong kilala mo nang mabuti at nag-iingat sa iyo.

question.en: What is the secret word only your family knows, used to check that someone was really sent to pick you up?
question.fil: Ano ang tawag sa sikretong salita na pamilya mo lang ang nakakaalam, na ginagamit para malaman kung talagang pinasundo ka sa isang tao?

explain.en: If someone does not know the code word, do not go with them.
explain.fil: Kung hindi alam ng tao ang code word, huwag sumama sa kanya.

question.en: You can tell whether someone is safe just by how they look.
question.fil: Malalaman mo kung ligtas ang isang tao base lang sa itsura niya.

explain.en: Pay attention to what a person asks you to do, not how they look.
explain.fil: Tingnan kung ano ang ipinapagawa sa iyo ng tao, hindi kung ano ang itsura niya.

question.en: The personal safety rule is: No, Go, Yell, ____.
question.fil: Ang personal safety rule ay: No, Go, Yell, ____.

explain.en: Say no, get away, make noise, and tell a trusted adult.
explain.fil: Tumanggi, lumayo, mag-ingay, at magsabi sa trusted adult.

question.en: Match each situation with the safest helper to go to.
question.fil: Itugma ang bawat sitwasyon sa pinakaligtas na taong mapupuntahan.

pairs.en: A store worker at the counter or a security guard
pairs.fil: Store worker sa counter o security guard

pairs.en: Lost at a fiesta with your family
pairs.fil: Naligaw sa fiesta kasama ang pamilya
Ang napagkasunduang meeting place ng pamilya

pairs.en: Your teacher or the school guard
pairs.fil: Ang teacher mo o ang school guard

explain.en: Safe helpers are people whose job is to help, in the place where you are.
explain.fil: Ang ligtas na matutulungan ay mga taong trabaho talaga ang tumulong, sa mismong lugar kung nasaan ka.

question.en: Name 3 pieces of information every child should memorize in case they get lost.
question.fil: Magbigay ng 3 impormasyon na dapat kabisado ng bawat bata kung sakaling maligaw.

show.en: full name, home address, a parent's or guardian's phone number, school name
show.fil: buong pangalan, address ng bahay, phone number ng magulang o guardian, pangalan ng school

explain.en: With this information, a helper can contact your family quickly.
explain.fil: Gamit ang impormasyong ito, mabilis na makokontak ng tutulong ang pamilya mo.

question.en: After school, a person you do not know says your mom sent them to pick you up, but they do not know the family code word. What should you do?
question.fil: Pagkatapos ng klase, may taong hindi mo kilala na nagsabing pinasundo ka raw ng mommy mo, pero hindi niya alam ang family code word. Ano ang dapat mong gawin?

choices.en: Say no, go back to your teacher or school guard, and ask them to call your parents
choices.fil: Tumanggi, bumalik sa teacher o school guard, at ipatawag sa kanila ang magulang mo

choices.en: Get in the car to ask questions
Wait with them outside the gate
choices.fil: Maghintay kasama niya sa labas ng gate

explain.en: The code word protects you. Your teacher or guard can check with your family.
explain.fil: Pinoprotektahan ka ng code word. Kayang i-check ng teacher o guard sa pamilya mo.

question.en: You are lost in a mall. Arrange these steps in order.
question.fil: Naligaw ka sa mall. Ayusin ang mga hakbang.

steps.en: Stay inside the mall; do not go outside or to the parking lot
steps.fil: Manatili sa loob ng mall; huwag lumabas o pumunta sa parking lot

steps.en: Go to a store counter or a security guard
steps.fil: Pumunta sa store counter o sa security guard

steps.en: Tell them your name and your parent's phone number
steps.fil: Sabihin ang pangalan mo at phone number ng magulang mo

steps.en: Wait with them until your family arrives
steps.fil: Maghintay kasama nila hanggang dumating ang pamilya mo

explain.en: Your family will look where they last saw you, and workers inside can call them.
explain.fil: Hahanapin ka ng pamilya mo kung saan ka nila huling nakita, at kaya kang tulungan ng mga worker sa loob na tawagan sila.

scene.en: Someone you met in an online game keeps asking for your photos and your school's name, and tells you to keep the chats a secret.
scene.fil: May nakilala ka sa isang online game na paulit-ulit na humihingi ng mga litrato mo at ng pangalan ng school mo, at sinasabihan kang ilihim ang usapan ninyo.

choices.en: Do not reply; block them, keep the messages, and tell a trusted adult
choices.fil: Huwag sumagot; i-block siya, i-save ang mga message, at sabihan ang trusted adult

explain.en: Being asked to keep secrets is a warning sign. You are never at fault, and adults can help report it.
explain.fil: Babala ang pagpapalihim. Hindi ikaw ang may kasalanan, at matutulungan ka ng adults na i-report ito.
